content: The FITkit is an immunological test specifically designed to measure natural rubber latex (NRL) allergens that are present in various rubber products, such as gloves. This testing method utilizes the enzyme immunometric assay technique, which employs highly specific monoclonal antibodies. These antibodies are developed to target clinically significant latex allergens found in NRL products. The FITkit is also referred to by its scientific names, EIA (enzyme immunoassay) or IEMA (immuno-enzyme-metric assay). FITkit is a registered trademark of Quattromed Ltd.
